verdict.rationale: Persistent memory across sessions is a fair axis for a coding agent like Aider, but the evidence pack does not document any automatic memory building or recall. The repository map (aider-docs-17) and the .aider.conf.yml configuration (aider-docs-18) are adjacent features: one builds codebase context and the other sets options, and neither persists learned knowledge between sessions. Git auto-commits are also adjacent, not agent memory.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions
